author: Fable (autonomous)
motivation: Latency dose is the only knob that moves both robustness (up) and clean retention (down). Points so far at the operating point: dose 0 (off) and dose 1 (fixed, 0-40 ms). Add dose 0.5 (0-20 ms) to map the frontier.

hypotheses.H_F1_retention: fixed_lat50 unseen id_clean >= 92 (recovers at least half the clean cost)
hypotheses.H_F2_robustness: fixed_lat50 seen dr_full >= 75 and lat_u60_common >= 65 (keeps most of the gain)
hypotheses.H_F3_frontier: fixed_lat50 lies strictly between off and fixed on both axes (monotone dose-retention frontier)
